mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference images 1 and 2 are style references only: match their flat posterized colour fills, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick and hatch marks for texture (like the cracked bark of reference 2) and muted palette of moss greens, earth browns and grey; do not copy their subjects.
Reference image 3 is the SCENE to keep: keep this same enormous ancient oak filling the frame, its gnarled spreading branches, its mossy bark, its spreading roots, the green forest behind and the brown leaf litter, in the same colours and camera position. Change only the hollow.
The hollow: the trunk is NOT split by a tall narrow opening. Instead there is one ragged, irregular, roughly round hole low in the trunk just above the roots, about as wide as it is tall, big enough to crawl into, its rim broken and jagged with splintered bark and lumpy knots, dark inside with dry brown leaves on its floor. Above the hole the trunk is solid and whole bark all the way up.
Subject: an enormous ancient hollow oak with a crawl-sized ragged round hole at the base of its trunk, moss on the roots, forest behind.
The ground is untouched: no footprints, no tracks, no prints of any kind.
Style: Card Survival Fantasy Forest game card art. Flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture. Thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks for texture. Muted naturalistic palette. Realistic proportions, nothing glossy, no fantasy glow. The painted scene reaches every edge of the frame. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: tall vertical slit, split trunk, long narrow opening, almond-shaped opening, oval opening, smooth-edged opening, symmetrical folds of bark around the hole, footprints, tracks, prints in the ground, birds, animals, people, mushrooms, golden light, sunbeams, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, anime, pixel art, neon colours, lens flare, watercolour, soft gradients, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, plain white background, vignette, white border.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Redo Review (second round, redrawn from the owner's notes on the first). Finished by /process-card-art --full-bleed.
